items.summary: Recommendation: keep production work focused on measurement and repair backlog this cycle. The only mandate candidate, rc-9.com, is blocked by an existing failed performance change (mobile performance 48, LCP 4,977 ms, TBT 1,513 ms). Do not duplicate active work on allthingsmasonic.com; its homepage refresh remains under measurement. The CRO CTA ideas for arttogogh.com lack confirmation of an eligible page and measurable existing CTA event. Portfolio evidence shows 155 approved proposals without execution, 41 failed requests, and 46 open repair items; no causal revenue lift is proven. Unknowns include page-level CTA instrumentation for arttogogh.com and root cause details for rc-9.com. Smallest next steps are CTO repair triage for rc-9.com and read-only CTA eligibility confirmation for arttogogh.com. Separately, SearchWoot remains private because source rights and technical/legal gates are blocked. Decision requested: authorize or decline sending a written permission request to Woot; no public launch is recommended.
